papers.title_en: A Candidate Counterexample to a Conjecture on ISS for Time-Delay Systems
papers.evidence: 时滞系统的李雅普诺夫-克拉索夫斯基泛函与输入-状态稳定性
papers.tldr: 时滞系统的输入到状态稳定性（ISS）常借助Lyapunov-Krasovskii泛函判定，已有猜想认为点态耗散率条件足以保证ISS。本文通过与大型语言模型交互，构造出一个候选反例，试图否定该充分性猜想。结果给出反例构造思路与关键机制，提示该Lyapunov判据可能过强或需附加条件。贡献在于为时滞ISS理论提供反例线索，并展示LLM辅助数学发现的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: We present a candidate counterexample to a conjecture stating that the existence of a Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional with a pointwise dissipation rate is sufficient for the input-to-state stability of time-delay systems. The counterexample has been derived through interactions with large language models.
